<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__tsSelectListener) return;
  window.__tsSelectListener = true;
  document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    var el = e.target;
    if (!el || !el.matches || !el.matches('select[data-track]')) return;
    var opt = el.options[el.selectedIndex];
    var line = el.closest('[data-track-product-id]');
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    window.dataLayer.push({
      event: 'select_change',
      track_event: el.getAttribute('data-track'),
      track_value: el.value,
      track_label: (opt && (opt.getAttribute('data-track-label') || opt.text)) || el.getAttribute('data-track-label') || undefined,
      track_section: el.getAttribute('data-track-section') || undefined,
      product_id: line ? line.getAttribute('data-track-product-id') : undefined,
      product_title: line ? line.getAttribute('data-track-product-title') : undefined,
      variant_id: line ? line.getAttribute('data-track-variant-id') : undefined
    });
  }, true);
})();
</script>

variable.name: cjs - selected_size
variable.notes: Size currently selected in the PDP / quick-add modal (for Add to Bag / Buy Now clicks)

variable.name: cjs - product_ctx
variable.notes: Product context: cart line attributes (data-track-product-*), else closest [data-track-product] wrapper (card, PDP, quick-add dialog). Sticky bar falls back to the PDP wrapper.

variable.name: cjs - wishlist_action
variable.notes: State BEFORE the click: heart already active (Wishlist Hero class wishlisthero-product-in-wishlist) = remove, else add. Verify the class in GTM Preview.

variable.name: cjs - size_selected
variable.notes: For quick_add_close. Inline (desktop) list: always false, picking a size adds and closes.

variable.name: cjs - click_items
variable.notes: GA4 items array for click-based ecommerce events (select_item, add_to_wishlist)

variable.name: cjs - is_pixel_sandbox
variable.notes: True inside the Shopify custom pixel sandbox (the pixel pushes ts_pixel: true before loading GTM).

variable.name: cjs - send_page_view
variable.notes: No GA4 page_view from the pixel sandbox (the theme page already sends one).

variable.name: cjs - page_location
variable.notes: Real page URL in the sandbox (pixel pushes page_location), else Page URL.

variable.name: cjs - pixel_items
variable.notes: GA4 items from the pixel payload (productVariant / cartLine / cart.lines / checkout.lineItems)

variable.name: cjs - pixel_content_ids
variable.notes: Meta content_ids from the pixel items
